test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Out of the four items listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.

Petal, Sepal, Pollen, Ligament
solution:
Given: Petal, Sepal, Pollen, Ligament.

Logic:

Petal, Sepal, and Pollen are all the parts of a Flower.

Whereas,

Ligament is a body part of the Human Beings.
